title: Scenario Auto-Block Status
description: 5 scenario auto-block: Criminal IP check, firewall auto-block (A) and block recommendations (B)

options.query: index=summary source IN ("scen_autoblock_eval","scen_autoblock_fg") scen_id="$scen$" | fields _time source rec_type scen_id scen_name pc pc_ip ip evidence sess detail cond_reason evt fg_status fg_text fg_error n_a n_b n_c n_d n_none cip_fail run_time

| search source="scen_autoblock_fg" fg_status="registered" | sort 0 _time | streamstats dc(ip) AS v | timechart span=1h max(v) AS v | filldown v | fillnull value=0 v | appendpipe [stats count | where count=0 | eval v=0 | fields v]

| search rec_type="recommend" | sort 0 _time | streamstats dc(ip) AS v | timechart span=1h max(v) AS v | filldown v | fillnull value=0 v | appendpipe [stats count | where count=0 | eval v=0 | fields v]

| search source="scen_autoblock_fg" (fg_status="failed" OR fg_status="unconfirmed") | sort 0 _time | streamstats dc(ip) AS v | timechart span=1h max(v) AS v | filldown v | fillnull value=0 v | appendpipe [stats count | where count=0 | eval v=0 | fields v]

| search rec_type="excluded" | sort 0 _time | streamstats dc(ip) AS v | timechart span=1h max(v) AS v | filldown v | fillnull value=0 v | appendpipe [stats count | where count=0 | eval v=0 | fields v]

| eval Result=case(source="scen_autoblock_fg" AND fg_status="registered","Auto-blocked", source="scen_autoblock_fg" AND (fg_status="failed" OR fg_status="unconfirmed"),"Block failed", rec_type="recommend","Recommended", rec_type="excluded","White list") | where isnotnull(Result) | stats dc(ip) AS IPs BY Result | eval o=case(Result="Auto-blocked",1, Result="Block failed",2, Result="Recommended",3, true(),4) | sort o | fields Result IPs
| stats sum(eval(if(Result="Auto-blocked",IPs,0))) AS a sum(IPs) AS t | eval v=if(isnull(t) OR t=0,0,round(a*100/t)) | fields v
| stats max(_time) AS t | eval v=if(isnull(t),"No record",strftime(t,"%m-%d %H:%M")) | fields v

| eval k=case(source="scen_autoblock_fg" AND fg_status="registered","Blocked", rec_type="recommend","Recommended", rec_type="excluded","White list") | where isnotnull(k) | chart dc(ip) OVER scen_name BY k | append [| makeresults | eval scen_name=split("Risky port access,Non-standard port access,Phishing / malicious link click,Malware infection,Firewall admin login",",") | mvexpand scen_name | fields scen_name] | stats sum(*) AS * BY scen_name | fillnull value=0 Blocked Recommended "White list" | eval o=case(scen_name="Risky port access",0,scen_name="Non-standard port access",1,scen_name="Phishing / malicious link click",2,scen_name="Malware infection",3,scen_name="Firewall admin login",4,true(),9) | sort o | fields scen_name Blocked Recommended "White list" | rename scen_name AS Scenario

| eval k=case(source="scen_autoblock_fg" AND fg_status="registered","Blocked", rec_type="recommend","Recommended") | where isnotnull(k) | timechart span=1d dc(ip) BY k | fillnull value=0 Blocked Recommended

| search source="scen_autoblock_fg" fg_status!="skipped" | sort 0 - _time | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), Result=case(fg_status="registered","Blocked", fg_status="failed","Block failed", true(),"Needs check"), Condition=if(scen_id="login_outbound", coalesce(cond_reason,"-"), sess." sessions") | table Time scen_name pc ip evidence Condition detail Result | rename scen_name AS Scenario, pc AS PC, ip AS "Risky IP", evidence AS "CIP evidence", detail AS Detail

| eventstats max(eval(if(source="scen_autoblock_fg" AND fg_status="registered",1,0))) AS blk BY ip | search rec_type="recommend" | sort 0 - _time | stats max(_time) AS t count AS seen dc(pc) AS pcs values(scen_name) AS scen first(evidence) AS ev max(sess) AS s max(blk) AS blk BY ip | eval "Last seen"=strftime(t,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), Status=if(blk=1,"Blocked later","Not blocked"), Scenario=mvjoin(scen,", ") | sort 0 blk - t | table "Last seen" ip ev Scenario pcs s seen Status | rename ip AS "Risky IP", ev AS "CIP evidence", pcs AS PCs, s AS "Max sessions", seen AS "Times seen"

| search rec_type="recommend" ip="$rec_ip$" | sort 0 - _time | stats max(_time) AS t count AS seen max(sess) AS s first(detail) AS d first(evt) AS e BY pc scen_name | eval "Last seen"=strftime(t,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort 0 - t | table "Last seen" scen_name pc s d e seen | rename scen_name AS Scenario, pc AS PC, s AS "Max sessions", d AS Detail, e AS "Event time", seen AS "Times seen"

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches splunk_server=local count=0 | rename search AS spl | where match(spl, "scen_id=\"(outbound_riskport|outbound_nonstd_port|phishing_click|malware_outbound|login_outbound)\"") | rex field=spl "scen_id=\"(?<scen_id>[a-z_]+)\"" | eval Enabled=if(disabled=1,"No","Yes"), Schedule=if(is_scheduled=1, cron_schedule, "Not scheduled"), Webhook=if(like(actions,"%webhook%"),"Yes","No") | fields title scen_id Enabled Schedule Webhook | join type=left max=1 title [ search index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler earliest=-24h latest=now savedsearch_name=* | stats count AS runs count(eval(len(alert_actions)>0)) AS triggered latest(status) AS last_status max(_time) AS last_run BY savedsearch_name | rename savedsearch_name AS title ] | join type=left max=1 scen_id [ search index=summary source="scen_autoblock_eval" rec_type="run" earliest=-24h latest=now | stats count AS recorded max(_time) AS rec_last BY scen_id ] | fillnull value=0 runs triggered recorded | fillnull value="-" last_status | eventstats sum(runs) AS all_runs | eval Verdict=case(Enabled="No","Disabled", Schedule="Not scheduled","Not scheduled", Webhook="No","No webhook", runs=0 AND recorded>0,"OK", all_runs=0,"No scheduler log", runs=0,"Not running", NOT in(last_status,"success","continued"),"Search failing", triggered>recorded,"Shuffle not recording", true(),"OK") | eval "Last run"=case(isnotnull(last_run), strftime(last_run,"%m-%d %H:%M"), isnotnull(rec_last), strftime(rec_last,"%m-%d %H:%M")." (Shuffle)", true(),"-"), o=case(scen_id="outbound_riskport",0,scen_id="outbound_nonstd_port",1,scen_id="phishing_click",2,scen_id="malware_outbound",3,scen_id="login_outbound",4,true(),9) | sort o title | table Verdict title scen_id Enabled Schedule Webhook "Last run" last_status runs triggered recorded | rename title AS Alert, scen_id AS Scenario, last_status AS "Last status", runs AS "Runs (24h)", triggered AS "Sent to Shuffle (24h)", recorded AS "Recorded by Shuffle (24h)"

| stats count(eval(Verdict="OK")) AS ok count(eval(Verdict!="OK" AND Verdict!="No scheduler log")) AS bad count AS t | eval v=case(t=0,"No alerts", ok=t,"OK", ok=0 AND bad=t,"Problem", true(),"Check") | fields v
| stats dc(Scenario) AS v | eval v=v." / 5"

index=summary source="scen_autoblock_eval" rec_type="run" earliest=-24h latest=now | sort 0 - _time | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%m-%d %H:%M"), Checked=tonumber(n_a)+tonumber(n_b)+tonumber(n_c)+tonumber(n_d)+tonumber(n_none) | table Time scen_name Checked n_a n_b n_c n_d n_none cip_fail | rename scen_name AS Scenario, Checked AS "Outside IPs", n_a AS "A blocked", n_b AS "B recommended", n_c AS "C white list", n_d AS "D not risky", n_none AS "No CIP result", cip_fail AS "CIP failures"

index=summary source="scen_autoblock_health" earliest=-24h latest=now | sort 0 - _time | eval Status=case(verdict="OK","OK", match(verdict,"^Warning"),"Warning", true(),"Problem") | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%m-%d %H:%M"), DHCP=n_dhcp.if(isnotnull(dhcp_last), " (last ".strftime(dhcp_last,"%m-%d %H:%M").")", ""), Defender=n_def.if(isnotnull(def_last), " (last ".strftime(def_last,"%m-%d %H:%M").")", "") | table Time Status verdict n_traffic n_out n_noip n_noport n_nodev n_nosess n_dev n_web n_av n_login n_sec_nosrc DHCP Defender | rename verdict AS Verdict, n_traffic AS "Traffic (15m)", n_out AS "PC to internet", n_noip AS "No IP", n_noport AS "No port", n_nodev AS "No firewall", n_nosess AS "No session", n_dev AS Firewalls, n_web AS "Web filter (24h)", n_av AS "Antivirus (24h)", n_login AS "Admin login (24h)", n_sec_nosrc AS "Security logs no PC IP (24h)", DHCP AS "DHCP (24h)", Defender AS "Defender (7d)" | appendpipe [stats count | where count=0 | eval Time="-", Status="No record", Verdict="No check in the last 24 hours.
